about: The must-haves from docs/VISUAL_DIRECTION.md that image metrics can't judge. Each run scores them by hand in docs/benchmark/runs/<run>/rubric.json as {"<id>": {"score": 0 | 0.5 | 1, "note": "..."}}. Copy the previous run's file and change what the new art changed.

items.text: The survivor is a hooded, leather-armoured painted sprite, small in frame, holding the torch
Enemies are painted sprites with distinct, readable silhouettes (goblin, ork, ogre, troll, beasts)
Wind-up poses read as telegraphs without the coloured status rings
Watchhouse walls are worn, crumbling painted stone with damage variants, not flat boxes
Ground is wet, mossy flagstone and mud that catches torchlight (puddle sheen)
Props match the mockup: iron-banded chest, barrels, leaning shield, collapsed timbers, banner
One warm torch pool on cold blue-grey night, fast falloff, most of the frame near-black
Flames, embers and smoke are painted flipbooks (torches, braziers, the shelter fire)
Mist and dark pines beyond the walls
Saturated colour only for fire, blood, heraldic red and rot green
PACK window: charcoal panel, serif title, weight line, 4-column icon grid with stack counts, gold selected border
Detail pane: item name, one-line description, USE / DROP buttons
Painted item icons for every item id (sheets 05, 10)
HUD is two thin bars (health, stamina) and three quick slots, bottom-left, no text clutter
